Housing Officer - East Sussex

12-Month Contract Hybrid Working

Are you an experienced Housing Officer looking for a longer-term contract where you can really take ownership of your patch?

We're recruiting two Housing Officers to join a busy housing team in East Sussex, managing a varied caseload and working directly with residents to help create safe, well-managed neighbourhoods.



The role

You'll manage your own neighbourhood patch, with responsibilities including:

  • Tenancy management and tenancy sustainment
  • ASB and tenancy breach cases
  • Estate inspections and neighbourhood management
